description.la: Ex Disputationibus de controversiis christianae fidei adversus huius temporis haereticos (1586-93): De sacramento poenitentiae. Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: From the Disputations on the Controversies of the Christian Faith (1586-93): the sacrament of penance: contrition, confession, satisfaction, indulgences. Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: Das Disputas sobre as controvérsias da fé cristã (1586-93): Sobre o sacramento da penitência.

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 4 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
